description: This file defines the LessThanOrEqualsOperator class, which implements a comparison operator for filtering and SQL query generation within a JSON API filter framework. It specifies methods for returning the filter operator tag, the corresponding SQL operator, and validating operators.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqualsOperator
classes.description: A comparison operator class for 'less than or equal to' filter operation, supporting conversion to filter tags and SQL operators, and validating input operators.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag representing the 'less than or equal to' operation.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string '<=' corresponding to the 'less than or equal to' comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided operator string is valid for this comparator, throws exception if not a string.
